title: Page 91
transc:
Beckwith (2) Sumter quarter
prompt  Wash June 11th 1864
Imogene Hawkins for Mars tulip I hope Crowd
will not put too much confidence in Barnard
stick I have no confidence in his judgement
on practical military affairs and believe that he
is in large degree responsible for McClellans blunders
yard He was sent down by Behead for
chart to use as an rockland if he
needed him but if trusted too far it
may lead to deplorable results tulip He will
never be ready never has enough and all
that he undertakes trifle in quincy of plaster
for want of proper comprehension of practical purposes
stop If Crowd trusts to his own judgement
we are safe but trust in Barn yard
is dangerous Comb set him up again


no 1.  410 p. m
Sheldon Ft. Monroe  Wash. D. C. June 12. 1864.
for Biggs Chf qm ---- An Expedition sixteen thousand
strong is to quorum at White House Whelp Send 
to that place immedy Every vessel fitted to aid
in this movement & in removing stores & wounded
to a new base or hospital signed Belcher Julia
